Chapter One

Kids Entertainment

  • Themed celebrations tailored to your child

Chapter Two

DJs

Premium DJs who read the room and conduct the night. From the first dance to the final song, the soundtrack is built around your guests — polished presentation, professional equipment, and a floor that stays full.

  • Weddings, birthdays, corporate and private parties
  • Requests welcomed and playlists planned with you

About the House

One agency.
Every kind of occasion.

Great entertainment is never an accident. It is cast, timed and cared for — down to the last song.
i.

A versatile company, not a single act

Children's parties in the afternoon, a headline DJ set at midnight. P1 Playhouse Live brings performers, DJs and live shows together under one roof, so one enquiry covers your whole event.

ii.

Professional from first call to final encore

Clear communication, careful planning and performers who arrive prepared. You always know what is happening, when, and who is delivering it.

iii.

Entertainment shaped around you

Your theme, your guests, your running order. Every booking starts with your occasion — never with a package we are trying to sell.
